description: This file provides helper functions for handling scheduler results, including space calculations for PUCCH and PUSCH PDUs, and extraction of grant information for PUSCH, PRACH, and PUCCH allocations within a 5G NR scheduler context.

methods.name: has_space_for_uci_pdu
methods.description: Checks if there is space for a new UCI PDU for a given C-RNTI in the scheduler result.

methods.name: get_space_left_for_pusch_pdus
methods.description: Calculates remaining space for PUSCH PDUs for a specific C-RNTI in the scheduler result.

methods.name: get_pusch_grant_info
methods.description: Extracts grant information from a PUSCH scheduling info.

methods.name: get_prach_grant_info
methods.description: Generates PRACH grant info for given PRACH occasions based on cell configuration.

methods.name: get_pucch_grant_info
methods.description: Extracts grant info for a PUCCH allocation, handling frequency hopping if present.
